source_notes: Poll closing times for the Nov. 3, 2026 general election, in Eastern Standard Time (DST ends Nov. 1, 2026). Primary compilations are 2026-specific: 270toWin 'Poll Closing Times' (2026 midterms) and The Green Papers G26 polling hours; mail-ballot deadlines from state law/news (Utah 2026). 'most_et' = time when most polls close; 'last_et' = last polls in the state. For all-mail states (CO, HI, OR, UT, WA) the value is the in-person ballot drop-off deadline. 12:00 a.m. and 1:00 a.m. refer to early Nov. 4 ET. Groups are by most_et; the 1:00 a.m. group is empty (only Alaska's Aleutians close then, as last_et). Individual polling places can close earlier; voters in line at closing may still vote.

ak.note: 8 p.m. AKST; Aleutian Islands west of 169°30' (Hawaii-Aleutian time) close 1:00 a.m. ET. Times are early Nov. 4 ET.

al.note: 7 p.m. CT; a few Eastern-time border localities may close 7 p.m. ET.

az.note: 7 p.m. MST (Arizona does not observe DST).

ca.note: 8 p.m. PT; every voter is mailed a ballot; in-person voting also available.

co.note: All-mail state: ballots must be received (drop box/voting center) by 7 p.m. MT = 9:00 p.m. ET.

fl.note: Most of state Eastern time (7 p.m. ET); western Panhandle in Central time closes 8:00 p.m. ET.

hi.note: All-mail state: ballots must be received / dropped off by 7 p.m. HST = 12:00 a.m. ET (Nov. 4). Voter service centers also close 7 p.m. HST.

id.note: 8 p.m. local; most of state Mountain time (10 p.m. ET); northern Panhandle in Pacific time closes 11:00 p.m. ET.

in.note: 6 p.m. local; most of state Eastern (6 p.m. ET); NW and SW corner counties in Central time close 7:00 p.m. ET.

ks.note: 7 p.m. local (counties may vary hours); four western counties in Mountain time close 9:00 p.m. ET.

ky.note: 6 p.m. local; eastern half in Eastern time (6 p.m. ET); western half in Central time closes 7:00 p.m. ET.

mi.note: 8 p.m. local; four Upper Peninsula counties in Central time close 9:00 p.m. ET.

nc.note: County boards may extend hours in extraordinary circumstances.

nd.note: Closing set locally (7-9 p.m. local); most Central-time precincts close 7 p.m. CT (8 p.m. ET); Fargo/Cass Co. 8 p.m. CT and Mountain-time SW counties 7 p.m. MT close 9:00 p.m. ET. Green Papers notes local option could run later.

ne.note: 8 p.m. CT / 7 p.m. MT - both zones close simultaneously.

nh.note: Closing set by town (no earlier than 7 p.m.); most towns close 7 p.m. ET, larger cities at 8 p.m. ET. Networks/AP treat 8 p.m. ET as the state's poll close.

nv.note: 7 p.m. PT; every voter is mailed a ballot.

or.note: All-mail state: ballots must be dropped off by 8 p.m. local (11:00 p.m. ET; Malheur Co., in Mountain time, 10:00 p.m. ET). Mailed ballots postmarked by Election Day also count if received within 7 days.

sd.note: 7 p.m. local; western Mountain-time half closes 9:00 p.m. ET.

tn.note: 8 p.m. ET / 7 p.m. CT - both zones close simultaneously.

tx.note: 7 p.m. local; El Paso and Hudspeth counties (Mountain time) close 9:00 p.m. ET.

ut.note: Effectively all-mail: ballots must be in election officials' hands (drop box/vote center) by 8 p.m. MT = 10:00 p.m. ET; postmark no longer sufficient (2025 law). In-person polls also close 8 p.m. MT.

wa.note: All-mail state: drop boxes close 8 p.m. PT = 11:00 p.m. ET; mailed ballots must be postmarked by Election Day.
